_doc: Equipment-configurable component mapping (§33). This layer is INDEPENDENT of any ML code. A backend response of {"inspection_area": "drive_assembly"} maps here to a named 3D mesh group and a human label. Highlighting is deterministic — driven by the predicted failure mode and top contributing factor, never random. The highlighted part is a PROBABLE INSPECTION AREA, not a physically confirmed fault.

cnc_milling.label: CNC Milling / Rotating Spindle Machine
cnc_milling.description: A generic rotating-spindle machining centre consistent with the AI4I sensor set: air/process temperature, rotational speed, torque, and tool wear.

components.label: Spindle
components.role: Rotates the cutting tool at the commanded speed.
components.info: The rotating shaft that holds and drives the tool. Sensitive to speed and balance; wear or imbalance shows up as vibration and heat.

components.label: Drive / Tool Assembly
components.role: Transmits motor torque to the spindle.
components.info: Couples motor output to the spindle. Sustained high torque combined with tool wear raises mechanical strain here first.

components.label: Tool Holder
components.role: Clamps the cutting tool to the spindle.
components.info: Holds the cutting tool. Accumulated tool wear degrades cut quality and can transfer load back into the holder and spindle.

components.label: Bearing Housing
components.info: Carries the spindle bearings. Overstrain and vibration shorten bearing life; failure here escalates quickly to spindle damage.

components.label: Coolant Line
components.role: Removes heat from the cut zone.
components.info: Delivers coolant to the tool/work interface. When process temperature approaches ambient with low airflow, heat is not being dissipated — the coolant path is the first thing to check.

components.label: Drive Motor
components.role: Provides mechanical power to the drive.
components.info: The prime mover. Power delivered is torque × angular speed; when that product leaves the safe band, the motor and its drive electronics are the probable area.
